Aides.discretion: Go unseen and unheard; scavenge quietly.
Aides.survie: Water, crops, fishing, hunting, orientation, plants.
Aides.soins: Dress wounds, heal, stabilise the dying.

Faits.reseau-carburant: {region}: not a drop of fuel left at the pump.
Faits.cyclone-pre-alerte: Cyclone pre-alert: {cyclone} is approaching, landfall in two days.
Faits.cyclone-rouge: Red alert: cyclone {cyclone} strikes the island.
Faits.eboulement: {region}: heavy rain, rockfalls on the road.
Faits.eruption: The volcano wakes: a red glow in the night.
Faits.menace-livides: Wandering Pallid prowl around the shelter.
Faits.menace-bande: {faction} are taking an interest in the shelter.
Faits.menace-animaux: A pack of stray dogs, starving.
Faits.menace-accident: An accident at the shelter (a fall, a kitchen fire, a tool that breaks).
Faits.voyage: The group sets out from {de} for {vers} ({chemin}, {quarts} watch(es)).
Faits.survivant-depart: {nom} leaves, at the end of their rope.
Faits.stocks-moins-un-jour-eau: Less than a day of water left.
Faits.stocks-moins-un-jour-nourriture: Less than a day of food left.
Faits.manque-nourriture: Not enough to eat for everyone ({n} share(s) short).
Faits.palier-visibilite: The shelter is getting more visible (visibility {visibilite}, tier {palier}).
Faits.recrue-raison-5: has been following the road for days
Faits.recrue-prix-1: asks for an equal share of the stocks
Faits.recrue-prix-2: wants help finding a loved one
Faits.proche-1: is looking for their sister, left behind at the hospital
Faits.proche-2: lost their father on the first night
Faits.proche-3: is waiting for news of their son, who went out fishing
Faits.proche-4: left their grandmother in the Hauts
Faits.proche-5: does not know where their partner is
Faits.abri-a-raconter-decouverte: {nom}: a find to narrate ({decouverte}), to be fetched.
Faits.besoin-soins: wounded or sick people and no healer
Faits.besoin-chantier: an open building site and no handyman
Faits.hors-service-reparer: {installation}: out of order, repair it first
Faits.site-souterrain: a suitable basement is needed (underground {requis}; here {ici})
Faits.esprit-observance-manquee: {nom} hasn't been able to keep what holds them up for days; they feel at fault.
Faits.esprit-reconfort: {nom} clings to what keeps them going.
Faits.esprit-regard-change: {nom} no longer sees things the same way.
Faits.esprit-retenu: The others are there, around {nom}. It matters.
Faits.esprit-au-bord: {nom} is on the verge of letting go.
Faits.esprit-faux-bruit: {nom} heard something in the night. Nobody else did.
Faits.malaise-couleur: {nom} no longer feels they belong in this group.
Faits.autorite-monte: People listen to {nom} more: everyone has eaten.
Faits.autorite-baisse: People listen to {nom} less: we went hungry.
Faits.desertion: {nom} deserted in the night: nobody listens to {chef} any more.
Faits.crise-scission: The group is splitting: some no longer follow {nom}.
Faits.tribut-du: The tribute to {bande} is due today.
Faits.porte-repart: {nom} didn't wait any longer and left.
Faits.porte-feu: A fire flares up in the night, right next to the camp. Nobody saw who lit it.
Faits.porte-feu-secret: The fire was {nom}, out of spite.
Faits.porte-revient: {nom} comes back, loaded with what you were missing, and asks again for a place.
Faits.porte-frappe-refugie: Someone knocks at the door: {nom} asks for a roof and something to eat.
Faits.porte-frappe-famille: Someone knocks at the door: {nom} asks for a place for their family ({n} more mouth(s) to feed).
Faits.porte-frappe-blesse: Someone knocks at the door: {nom} is wounded and asks to be cared for.
Faits.porte-frappe-dur: Someone knocks at the door: {nom} offers their arms and what they carry for a place.
Faits.porte-demande-refugie: {nom} asks for a roof and something to eat.
Faits.porte-demande-famille: {nom} asks for a place for their family ({n} more mouth(s) to feed).
Faits.porte-demande-blesse: {nom} is wounded and asks to be cared for.
Faits.porte-demande-dur: {nom} offers their arms and what they carry for a place.
Faits.porte-refuse: {nom} was turned away at the door.
Faits.porte-trahi: We took what {nom} brought, then sent them away.
Faits.porte-inconnu: nobody by that name is waiting at the door
Faits.chef-attaquer: The leader of {faction} has decided to attack.
Faits.chef-negocier: The leader of {faction} wants to talk.
Faits.chef-passer: The leader of {faction} moves on: they will settle elsewhere.
Faits.chef-ultimatum: The leader of {faction} issues an ultimatum: a tribute, or war.
Faits.chef-rejoindre: The leader of {faction} asks to join the group.

Erreurs.PasMembre: This survivor isn't in the group.
Erreurs.TributStocks: Not enough in stock to pay: {demande}.
Erreurs.SeparationImpossible: Choose who leaves (at least one, not everyone).
Erreurs.GraineCourte: Seed too short: it could be guessed. Leave the field empty (a safe random seed is drawn) or give one of at least 32 characters.
Erreurs.TropDePropositions: Too many proposals at once: wait a minute.
Erreurs.ChampReserve: Only the GM changes this: go through the sheet or the GM (task, test, creation).
Erreurs.PasMJActif: Only the active GM can do this (Fénoir's state is written on their side).
Erreurs.MondeFerme: Fénoir's world is not open in this browser (GM AI vault closed or shares awaited): nothing was written. It is being looked for; try again in a moment.
Erreurs.PasDePartie: No Fénoir game has started (GM window: Start).
Erreurs.DejaForce: This test has already been pushed (once per test).
Erreurs.SansMJ: No GM is connected: the GM is needed to write Fénoir's state.
Erreurs.SansReponse: The GM did not answer in time. Try again.
Erreurs.CreationFermee: Survivor creation is closed by the GM.
Erreurs.DejaUnSurvivant: You already have a living survivor.
Erreurs.TirageManquant: Nothing to create: roll a survivor first.
Erreurs.TirageInvalide: This roll does not come from the generator (budget, skills, equipment or traits): roll another one.
Erreurs.EnRoute: The group is on the road: wait until it arrives.
Erreurs.PasALAbri: The group is not at its shelter.
Erreurs.InstallationAbsente: This installation is not in the shelter.
Erreurs.AucuneFete: No holiday today: name the holiday.
Erreurs.PasDansLaRegion: The group is not in this region ({region}): it has to go there first.
Erreurs.Contenu: Fénoir: {n} error(s) in the content (first: {premiere}). Details in the console (F12).

Coffre.SansMoteur: Fénoir: the GM AI module is off; the real world state is kept in clear in the world settings. Players can read the world state.
Coffre.SansCle: Fénoir: the GM AI vault key is missing in this browser; the world could not be sealed (it will be as soon as the key is back: players' shares, another GM, backup key).
Coffre.EnAttente: Fénoir: the world is sealed; waiting for the players' key shares (or the backup key) to open it. Nothing is written until then.
Coffre.Ferme: Fénoir: the current game's world is not open in this browser. Nothing is written until it is.

VisibiliteSens.Aide: Who sees a survivor's colour (from red to blue): each their own (others by reputation), everyone, or only the GM.

DateDepart.Aide: The real date of day zero (YYYY-MM-DD): game date, season and holidays follow from it.

Budget.Aide: Sum of a starting player survivor's skill levels, "min-max" (10-16 by default).

RepartitionAuto.Aide: Each day, companions and recruits take the task the group needs most.

CreationOuverte.Aide: A player without a survivor can roll one ("Create a survivor" window); the active GM creates it and hands it over.

FetesJeu.Aide: The GM AI "Seasonal holiday" setting follows Fénoir's game date (daily card, decoration, narrator line).

Lumiere.Nom: Light follows the time of day
Lumiere.Aide: The active scene's darkness follows the time of day (unless the scene is locked).

Bandeau.Aide: The banner at the top of the screen: day, time, weather, stocks in days, alerts.

Signal.Aide: A discreet chime when the GM is waiting for you (a test, a task).

Ambiance.Aide: Night, rain, cyclone, tension during an assault, with the GM AI sounds.

Effets.Aide: Rain on the map, a slight shake during an assault. Nothing moves if your system asks for reduced motion.

Bandeau.Attente: Fénoir: the game has not started.

Fiche.NotesMJ: GM notes (secret, kept in the vault)
Fiche.NotesMJFermees: The world is not open in this browser: the secret notes are waiting for the vault.
Fiche.MalusAide: Dice removed from every test by condition (wounds, fatigue, morale, diseases).
Fiche.Craque: At the end of their rope: they break (GM scene).

Abri.PorteAide: What the shelter truly lacks, according to its stocks: the price of entry, and what someone who comes back brings.

Aides.defense: What protects the shelter from an assault (site, installations, minus damage).
Aides.visibilite: How far it can be seen and heard: it draws gangs and hordes.

Test.AideJoueurLibre: Without a request from the GM, this test is rolled at normal difficulty and gives no mark; a GM request sets the difficulty and makes it count.
Test.Compte: The test matters (danger, stakes): a progress mark if failed or pushed
Test.AideDialogue: Every 5 or 6 is a success. Condition penalties and tool bonuses are added automatically.
Test.ComplicationTexte: Complication: the GM chooses (noise, broken tool, light wound, lost time).
Test.Demande: The GM asks for a test

Assaut.Breche: BREACH: the shelter is broken into; fight, or flee.

Journal.endommagee: Assault ({type}): the shelter holds, but an installation is hit and someone is wounded.

Alertes.Mourant: {nom} is dying: a hard Medicine test, now, or they die at the end of the watch.
Alertes.Morsure: {nom} is bitten: EXTREME Medicine test within the watch (washing, cauterising…), HARD with a medicine (a zerbaz herbal brew counts as one), a zerbaz decoction (1 herb), a first-aid kit or an infirmary (medicine and decoction: +1 die each), or the Grey.

Journal.Chef: {nom} takes the lead of the group.
Journal.SansChef: The group no longer has a leader.
Journal.Tribut_hausse: Tribute paid to {bande}; next time it will be {demande}.
Journal.Tribut_alliance: The tribute has made {bande} an ally.
Journal.Tribut_revolte: The group refuses the tribute to {bande}: they will come.
Journal.Fusion: {nom} joins the group: we are one again.
Journal.Debut: Day zero, {date}: the group is in {region}.
Journal.Reprend: The group takes back the shelter of {site} ({region}).
Journal.Mordu: {nom} is bitten by one of the Pallid.

Fete.Effet: An extra ration for everyone; +1 morale for all.
Fete.Texte: The group celebrates {fete}: +1 morale each, an extra ration per person ({nourriture} food left).

Palier.Avis: Fénoir (GM): the shelter crosses the visibility threshold "{palier}". See the GM window, Threats tab.
Palier.SansTable: This threshold's table cannot be found (lakour-fenoir.tables compendium).

Signal.Test: The GM is waiting for a test from {nom}.
Signal.Jet: A test from your survivor is awaited.

Creation.Intro: Roll a survivor. Lock what you keep (name, age, childhood, background, traits), reroll the rest, or choose each element. Stars favour a skill on the next roll.
Creation.GraineRegion: On day zero, they were around {region}.
Creation.GraineRegionM: On day zero, he was around {region}.
Creation.GraineRegionF: On day zero, she was around {region}.
Creation.BudgetAide: Sum of levels: a starting survivor has between {min} and {max}.

Tableau.Carte: Réunion as the group knows it
Tableau.AideRenseignements: What the group BELIEVES, dated: a place may have changed since. Grey: never seen. Dotted roads: unknown.

Proposition.Aide: Propose an action to the GM (and the GM AI): they decide and have the group do it.

Atelier.Intro: {n} recipe(s) possible now. Hover a recipe for its description.

Aide.epreuve: They hold on by enduring (hunger, wounds, the cyclone).
Aide.refaire: They hold on by building and welcoming.
Aide.vivre: They hold on through small pleasures (a good meal, rest, a celebration, their passion).

Esprit.SensAide: From red (exclude, betray) to blue (welcome, help). Everyone sees their own; others know it by reputation.
Esprit.ReputationAide: What witnesses saw and repeated. It may be false.
Esprit.AutoriteAide: How much people listen when they lead: rises when they keep their word and everyone eats, falls when they ignore a vote.
Esprit.PratiqueAide: Practising: their morale can climb higher, but they must keep their observances. Not practising: little gain, no risk.

Projet.ailleurs: Wants to leave and found a better elsewhere

Communaute.Aide: The leader, harmony, the group's true colour (only you see it), the door, votes, tributes. Nothing is magical: faith works through morale.

Projet.vengeance: {nom} is revolted by what they saw and wants to leave, for revenge. Who might quietly help: {complices}.
Projet.ailleurs: {nom} is revolted by what they saw and wants to leave and found a better elsewhere. Who might quietly help: {complices}.

Communaute.Reputation: What people say of the group
Communaute.Trahir: Take what they bring, then send them away
Communaute.Circonstances: Mitigating circumstances (no room left, no food left)
Communaute.PersonneALaPorte: Nobody is waiting at the door.
Communaute.Question: The question
Communaute.VoteAide: Players say their vote out loud; companions, recruits and NPCs vote according to their compass.
Communaute.SigneAide: The cyclone left an object in the yard: everyone reads it according to their faith (a practising believer sees a sign, +1 morale). The game doesn't say who is right.

MJ.PasActif: You are not the active GM: only the active GM writes Fénoir's state.
MJ.Bloque: The world is not open in this browser: nothing is written.
MJ.DejaDemarree: A game is running: starting again replaces it.
MJ.Graine: Test seed (empty = a safe random seed; otherwise at least 32 characters)
MJ.AideMenaces: Rolled by the simulation against the shelter; nothing happens until you resolve them (assault) or set them aside (you narrate them otherwise).
MJ.Secret: The REAL world: for your eyes only. Players only know their intelligence.
MJ.MondeFerme: Real world unavailable (not the active GM, or vault closed).
